verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS registrar with an API and MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such control, so the verdict is none. WHOIS privacy (hiding contact details in public WHOIS) is a different, adjacent privacy feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
